description: Update policy (rationale: docs/updaters.md). Advisory fixes (Dependabot alerts plus OSV) for minor and patch updates automerge with no soak. Routine minor and patch updates automerge after a 7-day soak once CI is green. Digest moves (same tag, new digest), initial pins and majors always wait for a human, routine or advisory. Netcup-touching paths (scripts/**, .github/scripts/**, **/*.tf, **/.terraform.lock.hcl, examples/**) never automerge, security or not. Their routine updates group into one netcup-touching batch PR, except the Gatus and Caddy images in scripts/010-provision.sh, which sit outside the batch and follow the routine soak; their advisory fixes automerge with no soak. Gatus and Caddy on any other netcup-touching path never automerge. cad0p/semver-calver-release is operator-owned and never automerges. The OpenTofu pins (.opentofu-version and provision.yml tofu_version) move as one group. lockFileMaintenance is off; notifications use Renovate defaults.

customManagers.description: Gatus and Caddy docker images pinned in the provisioning script

packageRules.description: R1 routine: minor and patch updates automerge after a 7-day soak (strict internalChecksFilter holds the PR until the age passes). Digest and pin updates are excluded (R2b)
R2 majors (routine and advisory): human review, never automerged
R2b digest (same tag moved), initial pin and pinDigest updates: never automerge, routine or advisory. A moved tag is the hijack signature, so a human reviews it

R3 advisory fast lane: advisory minor and patch updates automerge with no soak. Soak removal comes from vulnerabilityAlerts (minimumReleaseAge null, force-applied). automerge cannot live in vulnerabilityAlerts because force keys win over every later rule, which would override the netcup deny rules (R4, R6)
R4 netcup-touching batch: routine and advisory bumps group into one PR with a label, never automerge. Gatus and Caddy are excluded here (R5 for scripts/010-provision.sh, R6b elsewhere)
R5 Gatus and Caddy images in scripts/010-provision.sh: outside the netcup batch; minor and patch automerge after the 7-day soak (advisory fixes take the R3 fast lane with no soak), majors human (R2)

R6 deny: advisory updates on netcup-touching paths never automerge. Gatus and Caddy are excluded, so this deny cannot override their advisory fast lane (R5, R6b handle them). Placed after R3 so it wins

R6b Gatus and Caddy on netcup-touching paths other than scripts/010-provision.sh: never automerge, any update type, advisory included. Batched with R4. The file scope stops an identically named dep elsewhere from inheriting R5
R7 OpenTofu CLI pins (.opentofu-version and provision.yml tofu_version) move together
R8 pin GitHub Actions to commit digests; the # vX.Y.Z comment is the version Renovate tracks
R9 OpenTofu setup-opentofu tofu_version input: a version string, never a digest (the github-actions manager reads it as a uses-with dep whose digest would not be a version)

R10 operator-owned: cad0p/semver-calver-release (self-validating via validate-* on pull_request, runs with contents: write) never automerges, any update type, advisory included. Placed last so no later rule can override it
